t: This is Redcliffe Gardens, a street in Chelsea, in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. It's a primary road, the A3220, and was developed between 1864 and 1878. Redcliffe Salaman was born here in 1874. He was a British physician and biologist who pioneered the breeding of blight-free potatoes. His 1949 book, The History and Social Influence of the Potato, established the history of nutrients as a new literary genre. He was also a key figure in the Anglo-Jewish community in the twentieth century.
